links.effect: No numbers in the abstract; RAG excels in challenging cases, with best settings differing between single- and multi-document QA datasets, but is limited in temporal reasoning cases

links.quote: Our quantitative analysis reveals challenging cases where RAG excels while still showing limitations in cases requiring temporal reasoning.
